items.title: Agent Explorative Policy Optimization for Multimodal Agentic Reasoning
items.summary_short: Vision-language models with extended reasoning succeed on complex problems, but many real-world problems require external tools that internal reasoning alone often cannot resolve.
items.spotlight_comment: Vision-language models with extended reasoning succeed on complex problems, but many real-world problems require external tools that internal reasoning alone often cannot resolve.

items.title: From Pixels to Words -- Towards Native One-Vision Models at Scale
items.summary_short: Current vision-language models (VLMs) typically stitch together separate image encoders and language decoders via multi-stage alignment, a modular framework that inevitably fragments pixel-level signals across frames and scatters early pixel-word interactions.
items.spotlight_comment: Current vision-language models (VLMs) typically stitch together separate image encoders and language decoders via multi-stage alignment, a modular framework that inevitably fragments pixel-level signals across frames and scatters early pixel-word

items.title: Gamma-World: Generative Multi-Agent World Modeling Beyond Two Players
items.summary_short: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal.
items.spotlight_comment: World models for interactive video generation have largely focused on single-agent settings, where future observations are generated from a single control signal.

items.title: Self-Improving Language Models with Bidirectional Evolutionary Search
items.summary_short: Search has been proposed as an effective method for self-improving language models and agentic systems, both for post-training sample generation and for inference.
items.spotlight_comment: Search has been proposed as an effective method for self-improving language models and agentic systems, both for post-training sample generation and for inference.

items.title: ResearchMath-14K: Scaling Research-Level Mathematics via Agents
items.summary_short: The frontier of mathematics is defined by problems whose solutions are not yet known, yet it remains unclear whether language models can meaningfully engage with such problems without human intervention. A major obstacle is the lack of large-scale research-level math datasets.
items.spotlight_comment: The frontier of mathematics is defined by problems whose solutions are not yet known, yet it remains unclear whether language models can meaningfully engage with such problems without human intervention.

items.title: MemTrace: Tracing and Attributing Errors in Large Language Model Memory Systems
items.summary_short: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug. Tracing memory's dynamic evolution is crucial to understand how information is synthesized, propagated, or corrupted over time.
items.spotlight_comment: Memory is essential for enabling large language models to support long-horizon reasoning, yet existing memory systems remain unreliable and difficult to debug.

items.title: Learn from Weaknesses: Automated Domain Specialization for Small Computer-Use Agents
items.summary_short: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently made substantial progress, but deploying a separate large expert for each software domain remains expensive.
items.spotlight_comment: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have recently made substantial progress, but deploying a separate large expert for each software domain remains expensive.

items.title: GEM: Generative Supervision Helps Embodied Intelligence
items.summary_short: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks.
items.spotlight_comment: Embodied Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance and generalization in robotics, particularly within Vision-Language-Action frameworks.

items.title: DenoiseRL: Bootstrapping Reasoning Models to Recover from Noisy Prefixes
items.summary_short: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement.
items.spotlight_comment: Reinforcement learning has become a central paradigm for advancing reasoning in large language models, yet most existing methods still depend on stronger teacher models or heavily curated difficult datasets, limiting scalable capability improvement.

items.title: OSP-Next: Efficient High-Quality Video Generation with Sparse Sequence Parallelism, HiF8 Quantization, and Reinforcement Learning
items.summary_short: Diffusion Transformers achieve strong video generation quality, but the quadratic cost of full attention limits efficiency. We introduce OSP-Next, an efficient text-to-video generation model that integrates sparse attention, parallelism, quantization, and reinforcement learning.
items.spotlight_comment: Diffusion Transformers achieve strong video generation quality, but the quadratic cost of full attention limits efficiency.
